operational_rules_learned_the_hard_way: backend `npm run lint` is `eslint --fix` and rewrites source. Gate on `npx eslint "{src,apps,libs,test}/**/*.ts"` instead.
Run backend unit tests as `TZ=UTC npm run test:unit`; some specs count periods against fixtures and flip under other offsets.
Jest here is v30: the flag is `--testPathPatterns` (plural).
Frontend `npm run test` takes ~10 minutes (627 files). Budget for it; run the single file with `npx vitest run <path>` while iterating.

transactions.status is NULLABLE (schema.sql:274). Never `status != 'VOID'` / `Not(TransactionStatus.VOID)` -- it drops NULL-status rows. Use the entity's isVoid getter in JS, or `(t.status IS NULL OR t.status != 'VOID')` in SQL.

Reuse an existing translated key across namespaces where the copy is identical (payees.service.ts borrows errors.transactions.categoryNotFound). Locale parity then stays green and no localization pass is owed; a new en-only errors.json key costs ~36 parity failures.

A nested withScopedDb JOINS the ambient transaction, so an assertXOwned helper opening its own withScopedDb still refuses before the caller's write. Findings written against the pre-RLS code will ask for a QueryRunner manager -- there are none left in src/ and lint bans them.
createScopedDbMocks THROWS for an unregistered entity: adding a repository read means registering [Entity, mock] in the spec.

Verify every regression test by actually reverting the fix and re-running. Some tests deliberately pass either way (they pin a boundary, e.g. 'null still clears without a lookup'); only the revert run tells those apart from vacuous ones.

A mock must have the shape the real collaborator returns. A plain `{ status: 'VOID' }` literal has no isVoid getter, so a test asserting void-filtering passes against unfixed code. Use Object.assign(new Entity(), {...}) when the claim is about a getter.
escalate_rather_than_implement: Most of what remains in open/ is financial calculation. Escalate (write a DEC) when the finding admits more than one defensible numeric answer -- that is the common case in loan-schedule.ts, loan-history.ts and rate-change-inference.service.ts. REV-004 (annualization by calendar-day gaps) changes the inference formula and is the clearest example. Implement only where an explicit CLAUDE.md rule or an in-repo pattern fixes the answer, as with REV-039 ('a failed lookup is not an empty dataset') and REV-008 (voided rows are out of the ledger).
